Before you begin

Warm-up

  1. What do you often say when you meet someone new?

  2. What do you like doing in your free time?

  3. What place do you like to visit?

Typing practice

Type the text exactly. Timer starts with your first key.

Text to type: An About Me talk can begin with a name and a home city. It can also name who lives with you. These details give the listener a clear picture of your home life. Ken is from Osaka, Japan. He lives in Osaka with his wife. Osaka is a city in Japan. In the second sentence, the word “with” adds another person to the picture of Ken’s home.

Part 2: Work and Free Time

Typing practice

Type the text exactly. Timer starts with your first key.

Text to type: Next, Ken talks about his normal week. He gives information about work. Then he moves from busy time to free time. He works at a small camera shop. His week is often busy. When he has free time, he likes walking. He also likes taking photos, because the streets are quiet. The word “because” gives a reason. Ken does not only name what he likes. He also explains why he likes taking photos.

Typing practice

Type the text exactly. Timer starts with your first key.

Text to type: Now Ken talks about weekends. He begins with things he does often. Then he adds something he does only sometimes. After that, he names a favorite place and gives two reasons. On weekends, he usually walks and drinks coffee. Sometimes he goes to a park with his wife. His favorite place is Osaka Castle park, because the walk is easy and the trees are nice. Osaka Castle is a castle and park in Osaka.

Part 4: An Interest and Its Story

Typing practice

Type the text exactly. Timer starts with your first key.

Text to type: An interest can have a story behind it. Ken first names something he likes. Then he explains how that interest began. He finishes with something he does now. He likes old cameras. He started to like them because his father had one. These days, he takes photos of the river. “Started to like” looks back to the beginning. “These days” brings the talk back to Ken’s life now.

Typing practice

Type the text exactly. Timer starts with your first key.

Text to type: The last part looks ahead. Ken talks about a place he wants to visit. He also names something new he wants to try and explains why it sounds fun. Later, he wants to visit Kyoto for a weekend. One thing he wants to try is a night photo class. He thinks it would be fun because city lights look different at night. Kyoto is a city in Japan. Words such as “later” and “wants to” show that these are future plans.

Typing practice

Type the text exactly. Timer starts with your first key.

Text to type: Now use the same order for your own talk. This lesson shape keeps the facts in order, then gives you blank About Me lines. Add your information to each blank. First read the lines as they are. Hi! My name is ________. I am from ________, Japan. I live in ________ with ________. I am a ________ / I work at ________.
